companies.description:
Founded in 1942, Supreme is an acknowledged leader of India's plastics industry. Handling volumes of over 6,40,000 tonnes of polymers annually effectively makes the country's largest plastics processors.

Not surprisingly, we also offer the widest and most comprehensive range of plastic products in India. 

Our 29 advanced plants are powered by technology from world leaders, and complement our extensive facilities for R & D and new product development. In fact, Supreme is credited with pioneering several products in India. These include Cross- Laminated Films, HMHD Films, Multilayer Films, SWR Piping Systems and more.

Supreme Industries Limited is India's leading plastic processing company with eight business divisions. The company has forayed into different types of plastic processing in Injection Moulding, Rotational Moulding (ROTO), Extrusion, Compression Moulding, Blow Moulding etc.

Supreme Industries Limited offers a wide range of plastic products with a variety of applications in Plastic Piping Systems, Moulded Furniture, Multi Cross Laminated Films, Industrial Moulded Products, Protective Packaging Product, Material Handling Products, Performance Films & Composite LPG Cylinders.

companies.name: Godrej Industries Group
companies.description:
At the Godrej Industries Group, we serve over 1.1 billion people globally through a diverse portfolio of businesses, united by our purpose of Crafting tomorrow. With revenues of USD 6.1 billion in FY25 and a market capitalisation of USD 27.5 billion as of 31 March 2025, we operate across FMCG, real estate, financial services, agriculture, and chemicals. We are the leading player in India across several business categories, including residential real estate, animal feed, crude palm oil, oleochemicals, household insecticides, hair colour, and air care.

We are committed to building a more sustainable future through our Good & Green programme, with ambitions of net-zero operations by 2035 and responsible supply chains by 2047. In 2025, Godrej Consumer Products and Godrej Properties were both ranked number one globally in their respective categories on the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Sustainability Indices.

companies.name: ITL Industries Ltd.
companies.description:
ITL Industries Ltd (BSE Listed) has been driving innovation in high-speed metal sawing and cutting solutions for over 40 years. We engineered India’s first indigenous Double Column Bandsaw Machines and now offer a comprehensive portfolio of 52+ horizontal and vertical bandsaw models—ranging from 100 mm to 3000 mm capacities, with manual, semi-automatic, fully automatic, NC, and CNC options to meet every industrial need.

ITL pioneered India’s first NC Carbide Circular Saw Metal Cutting Machine and currently offers 8 advanced models for 50 mm to 250 mm bar cutting, supporting the evolving requirements of engineering industries. By the end of 2023, more than 1,500 ITL machines have been commissioned across India and internationally, reflecting our global reputation for reliability and performance.

Our distinguished clientele includes over 4,320 blue-chip customers, operating a remarkable 16,500+ ITL machines worldwide—a testament to our trust and leadership in the industry.

As an “Affordable Metal Cutting Solution Provider”, ITL remains at the forefront of domestic and global markets by continuously introducing new technologies and upholding a steadfast commitment to delivering innovative, cost-effective, and reliable solutions for high-speed metal sawing applications.

companies.name: Exide Industries Limited
companies.description:
For more than seven decades, Exide has been one of India's most reliable brands, enjoying unrivalled reputation and recall. Our constant emphasis on innovation, extensive geographic footprint, strong relationship with marquee clients and steady technology upgradations with global business partners have made us a distinct frontrunner in the lead-acid storage batteries space for both automotive and industrial applications.

Exide designs, manufactures, markets and sells the widest range of lead acid storage batteries in the world from 2.5Ah to 20,600Ah capacity, to cover the broadest spectrum of applications. Using the latest technological inputs, we manufacture batteries for the automotive, power, telecom, infrastructure projects, computer industries, as well as the railways, mining and defence sectors.

Proven Pioneer in Innovation
As Karnavati Engineering, we were among the first Indian manufacturers to develop and commercialize small-batch (R&D) Tablet Press machines, transforming pharmaceutical research and development across laboratories and institutions.

Global Engineering Authority
With installations in 60+ countries, IRM Enterprises has built strong credibility across regulated and emerging pharmaceutical markets worldwide.

Integrated Manufacturing Excellence
From our advanced manufacturing facility in Kadi, Gujarat, we design and produce high-performance Tablet Compression Machines, Fully Automatic Capsule Filling Machines, and KALWEKA R&D equipment.

Engineering Meets Compliance
Every machine is engineered to meet stringent global cGMP and ISO 9001:2015 standards, ensuring reliability, consistency, and regulatory readiness.

From the iconic Mini Press series for R&D to high-speed industrial production systems, the Rimek brand by IRM Enterprises represents engineering you can trust—performance that never stops.

Key Specialties:

Tablet Compression Machines | Capsule Filling Machines | Tablet Tooling (Punches & Dies) | Salt & Bolus Press Machines | Lab-scale R&D Equipment | Turnkey Pharmaceutical Solutions

companies.name: Force Motors Ltd
companies.description:
Force Motors was established in 1958 by Shri N. K. Firodia with the vision of providing affordable commercial transport for the masses by harnessing the best available technology & offering economical, reliable, and efficient products.
Today, Force Motors is a fully vertically integrated automobile company with expertise in the design, development, & manufacture of a full range of automotive components, aggregates, vehicles, & agricultural tractors. Its ‘Traveller’ & ‘Trax’ vehicle ranges are market leaders in their respective segments. Force Motors is the flagship of the company group headed by Dr. Abhay Firodia, which has nine manufacturing units across the country & a 10,000-strong workforce. Since 1997, when Daimler AG took the decision to manufacture Mercedes cars in India, every engine fitted there has been produced at Force Motors. To date, it has supplied over 152,000 engines to Mercedes-Benz India & has a state-of-the-art dedicated facility in Chakan, Pune. In 2015, BMW assigned Force Motors to produce & test the engines for all cars & SUVs to be made in India. A state-of-the-art factory has been built to the exact standards of BMW by Force Motors in Chennai, close to their factory. Till date, Force Motors has supplied over 70,000 engines to BMW.
In March 2018, Force Motors entered into a joint-venture agreement with Rolls-Royce Power Systems AG. This venture, named "Force MTU Power Systems Pvt. Ltd., manufactures and supplies worldwide the 10- and 12-cylinder Series 1600 engines (545 hp to 1050 hp) for power generation & underfloor rail applications.
Force Motors introduced the Gurkha BS6, a powerful off-roader styled after the legendary Mercedes G-Wagon. It combines extreme off-roading capabilities with on-road handling.
The new Force Urbania is a premium modular panel van designed in consultation with global engineering experts. It offers maximum passenger space, comfort, and international safety standards including airbags for the driver & co-driver.

companies.name: TATA AutoComp Systems Ltd
companies.description:
Established in 1995, Tata AutoComp Systems plays a key role in introducing advanced auto-component technologies to the evolving Indian & Global automotive market. We specialize in the design, development, manufacturing, and supply of a broad range of automotive products and services. These offerings support OEMs across passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, two- and three-wheelers, tractors, off-road vehicles, allied industrial segments, and the aftermarket.
 
Tata AutoComp Systems operates through multiple divisions, including subsidiaries and joint ventures. It comprises 20 business units (10 fully owned, of which 3 are service units, and 10 joint ventures), established in partnership with leading global auto-component companies. With a global footprint of 74 manufacturing facilities across India, North America, Latin America, Europe, and China, Tata AutoComp ensures high-quality automotive solutions at a global scale, supported by a workforce of over 22,000+ employees.
 
Tata AutoComp has established an independent Electric Vehicle Component Business Vertical that delivers a comprehensive range of products, from battery packs and e-traction motors to battery cooling systems, electric compressors, and EV chargers. Tata AutoComp has expanded its presence across passenger, commercial, two- and three-wheeler, and industrial segments. Strategic partnerships with Gotion for battery packs and Prestolite for powertrain solutions have strengthened our position in the EV component market. We are at the forefront of the EV transformation journey, developing components for the emerging EV market and offering lightweighting solutions.
 
Vision: To be the Most Trusted Mobility Components and Systems Partner.
 
Mission: Deliver value to all stakeholders by differentiation through safety, quality, and constant innovation.
 
Our Values: Integrity, Pioneering, Excellence, Unity, Responsibility.

companies.name: Roots Industries India Limited
companies.description:
Roots Industries India Limited (RIL) established in 1970 is the flagship company of the Roots Group and its products find pride of place in some of the world’s most respected automobile brands. RIL has a full-fledged manufacturing facility in India, Malaysia, Russia and has offices in strategic locations across the world.

The company manufactures a wide range of Electric Horns, backup alarm and electronic horns with multi-functional capabilities for passenger vehicles, off-road vehicles and material handling equipment.

It has subsequently added to its product offerings with halogen bulbs, disc brake pads, brake shoes, clutch plates, batteries and reverse sensors.

RIL established a High Precision Engineering Division (HPED) in 2005 to manufacture Highly Critical Parts, Sub Assemblies and High Level Assemblies for the Medical, Aerospace, Flow Control, Automobile & Other Engineering Industries.

RIL established ROOTS METROLOGY and got accredited by NABL in 2005. It also addresses the Group’s calibration requirements and opened up branches in Chennai and Bangalore. In addition to calibration other services rendered by metrology division are Third Party inspection and Training & Development.

RIL established a commercial furniture manufacturing division ROOTS SYONA in 2013 to manufacture ergonomically designed furniture’s. Syona currently has more than 5 models of commercial chairs and will unveil other furniture products in a phased manner.

In the dynamic world that is driven by technology, a successful presence depends on the way you mould that technology to fit popular needs, Indigenous talent, a daring attitude, courage to accept and learn new things and the simple spark of an idea. That is the genesis of ROOTS.

companies.name: CIE Automotive India Ltd.
companies.description:
CIE Automotive India Limited (‘CIE India’) is a multinational company and a subsidiary of the CIE Automotive Group of Spain. It is listed on the BSE Limited (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE). CIE India is the CIE Automotive Group's platform to operate all of it’s automotive components business in South East Asia across all production technologies and forging technology worldwide.

CIE India today is a large diversified ‘Tier 2’ auto-components company which manufactures parts, not systems and aggregates, but these parts are complex, and value added thus differentiating it from other ‘tier 2 parts’ companies. CIE India is focused on the automotive market – cars, utility vehicles, commercial vehicles, two wheelers and tractors.

CIE India is a multi-locational and multi-technology business with engineering capabilities and manufacturing facilities in India, Spain, Lithuania, Italy, and Mexico. CIE India has an established presence in each of these locations and supplies automotive components to customers based there and overseas. Our manufacturing locations are generally located close to major automotive manufacturing hubs to facilitate supplies to our customers. In certain instances, we also provide services such as value analysis and value engineering to add value to our customers' products. Our unique combination of specialization in high value-added products, which is usually delivered directly to OEMs and our presence across multiple production technologies, differentiates us from other component suppliers.

companies.name: Gabriel India Limited
companies.description:
Gabriel India Limited, established in 1961, is the flagship company of the ANAND Group and a publicly listed auto ancillary manufacturer in India. Over the past six decades, the company has built state of the art integrated manufacturing operations spanning nine plants and three satellite facilities. These are supported by a strong R&D team of over 80 specialists, among the largest in the industry with 87 patents filed. Gabriel serves every major mobility segment, from two-and three-wheelers to passenger cars, commercial vehicles, railways, and e-bikes. 
In addition to supplying components to leading OEMs, Gabriel is also a leading player in the aftermarket segment, with a presence in over 25 countries. 

The company’s innovation ecosystem is supported by advanced technology and engineering centres in India and Europe, focused on developing next-generation solution, including suspension, automotive fasteners, and sunroof, across vehicle segments. The Gabriel Europe Engineering Centre (GEEC) in Belgium plays a key role in enhancing global engineering capabilities, fostering international collaboration, and aligning product development with evolving global mobility trends.
As part of its strategic expansion, Gabriel is actively diversifying its portfolio through strategic partnerships, including collaborations with Inalfa Roof Systems, Netherlands, for premium sunroof systems; SK Enmove, South Korea, for lubricants and EV fluids; and Jinhap Co, South Korea, for automotive fasteners. These partnerships are aimed at strengthening Gabriel’s capabilities and reinforcing dedication to shaping the future of mobility.

companies.name: Vollmann Group
companies.description:
Vollmann Group: Alles aus einer Hand - seit über 114 Jahren.

Unser Herz schlägt für Metall.

Wir sind Experten in der Metallverarbeitung. Mit 60 Projektingenieuren unterstützen wir unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und dem Bau von mehr als 100 Neuprojekten pro Jahr und verarbeiten jährlich rund 140.000 Tonnen Stahl, 1.000 Tonnen Edelstahl, 10.000 Tonnen Aluminium und hochfeste Stähle. Damit produzieren wir über 450 Millionen Stanz-, Tiefzieh- und Rohbauteile sowie komplexe Baugruppen mit einem Teilepreis von 7 Cent bis 70 Euro für circa 5.000 verschiedene Artikel der Tier 1- und OEM-Kunden in der Automobilindustrie.

 Wir bringen Kunststoff in Form.

Hand in Hand arbeiten unsere Projektingenieure der Kunststofftechnik mit den Kollegen der Metallverarbeitung. Gemeinsam mit den Kunden suchen wir nach Leichtbau-Lösungen und verarbeiten bereits glasmattenverstärkte Thermoplaste. Aber auch 2K- und Hybridtechnik gehören zu unserem ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Wir bringen über 3.000 Tonnen technisch anspruchsvoller Kunststoffgranulate für Funktions- und Sichtteile in Form und produzieren über 100 Millionen Kunststoffbauteile mit einem Teilepreis von 1 Cent bis 10 Euro für die Kunden der Automobilindustrie

 1.000 Möglichkeiten bei uns.

Die Vollmann Group ist ein verantwortungsvolles Familienunternehmen mit einer über hundertjährigen krisenfesten Tradition und dem Mut, innovative Wege einzuschlagen. Als zuverlässiger Arbeitgeber sind wir mit unseren Standorten eng verbunden. Wir bauen auf unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter, denn ihr Wissen und ihre Stärken sind das Potenzial der Unternehmensgruppe.

Wir erwirtschaften rund 400 Mio. € Gruppenumsatz mit ca. 1.750 Mitarbeitenden auf über 170.000 qm Produktionsfläche an 15 Standorten (Deutschland: 11, Tschechien: 2, Ungarn: 2).

companies.name: Riva Group
companies.description: Riva Group contributes to the dynamics of a healthy economy based on the principles of environmental sustainability and respect for mankind. The main goal is to improve the quality of life of stakeholders through direct contribution to economic, social and environmental dynamics. Founded in 1954 by Emilio Riva, a pioneer in postwar Italian steel sector, the Group has specialized in the manufacturing of “long” products using electric arc steelworks, and in more than 60 years of business it has achieved an international leadership, expanding in the main European countries, thanks to high production standards, steady strategy of growth and investments. The production activity is based on circular and non-extractive economy that promotes recycling of end-of-life steel. Chaired by Claudio Riva since May 2014, the Group is privately owned and boasts over 5.500 employees, with an increasingly qualified presence of high school and university graduates. Italy, with its Headquarter, France, Germany, Belgium, Spain and Canada are the countries in which Riva Group contributes to the local and international economy. The Riva Group maintains an important market share in “long” products - over 10% in the European Union area - which confirms its leadership position in this important market segment. The Group implements yearly a significant investment program aimed at innovating the steel recycling process, improving the qualitative aspects of products and processes, the safety conditions of the employees in the plants and the environmental compatibility of production. The Group supplies various product sectors, some of which - such as mechanics, automotive and earthmoving - require particularly high-quality standards. The production includes, among other items, drawn, peeled and grinding products deriving from the further cold processing of the rolled products.
